Operator log LIVE

    Hamilton quick reference · source & simulator limits

    Based on the Hamilton VisionTime manual, MN04009E ↗, including Figure 1 on page 6. Button groups and keypad legends were checked against that drawing and the controller photographs/drawings ↗. The optional TEAM NAMES row follows the manual. Inactive blank positions are preserved. The touch layout uses the same ordering, scaled for readability.

    Starting: NEW GAME, CLEAR, then choose 1 for countdown (0 counts up). Confirm the period, minutes, seconds and hundredths with ENTER. Blank entry accepts the displayed value. SET TIMER edits time in separate fields; PERIOD moves to the next period setup.

    Scores: SCORE adds a goal. RECALL followed by the appropriate SCORE key opens a correction. Enter the total and confirm.

    Penalties: PENALTY, ENTER for normal, jersey number, ENTER, minutes, ENTER, seconds, ENTER. To release a penalty: RECALL, PENALTY, CLEAR, ENTER. Use +/− to select a line when there are two penalties.

    Intermission: INTERMISSION switches to a separate warm-up/break clock. GAME TIMER RUN/HOLD controls it. RECALL, INTERMISSION, 0, ENTER, 0, ENTER ends it. The game clock and penalties are preserved.

    Time of day: RECALL, TIME OF DAY displays local Toronto time. RECALL, SET TIMER returns to the game display.

    Team names: TEAM NAMES selects a team. Repeated digits cycle the letters printed on that simulator key; + advances a character, − moves back, ENTER saves. RECALL, TEAM NAMES restores the previous name. The keypad follows the panel legends: 2 ABC, 3 DEF, 4 GHI, 5 JKL, 6 MNO, 7 PRS, 8 TUV, 9 WXY, 0 QZ. A advances, B goes back, C clears, D recalls, * selects ALT PEN and # confirms.

    Limits: Two penalty lines per team, no queue. AUTO HORN, TIME OUT, SHOTS and ABORT are included; advanced penalty editing is limited in this profile. ALT PEN previews delayed/misconduct entry with a held timer; activation and advanced penalty administration are not simulated. Use normal penalties for the drills. No automatic release after a goal. Practice defaults are configurable, not league rules. Console beeper, firmware settings, wiring and remote switches are omitted. Reloading resets the practice session.

    Optional remote practice is available in Remote controls below the console. Review the accessory selector for supported hardware, connection rules and mode assumptions.
